title: Click results (the file capture.json names as files.controls, <key>.controls.json)
description: Supplementary schema (spec 17 is silent; shape from M9). What each control of one captured item did when the capture clicked it, one entry per control. A bare array, as check M9 reads it, so it carries no schemaVersion; the capture manifest that names it does.

reached.description: true when every marker of the target state appeared after the click.

why.description: When not reached: what was missing or what went wrong, in one line.

verifyTarget.description: false when the plan puts the target out of one click's reach from this item (another world, pane or role): the click is still made, `reached` then says only that it landed, and M9 does not judge the target. Absent means the target was checked.
